introHtml: For brands that sponsor 5Ks, marathons, or triathlons, standard BBQ gear misses the mark. Custom running BBQ grilling items combine the energy of race day with the comfort of post-event cookouts. Think lightweight aprons that don't weigh runners down, portable grilling tools for tailgates, or branded water bottles that double as hydration gear. These aren't generic giveaways—they're purpose-built for active audiences who appreciate function as much as brand exposure.
